mouse.description: How a shake while dragging is recognized
mouse.blocklistTitle: Apps where the shelf doesn't open
mouse.blocklistDesc: Shaking, or holding a drag at the screen edge, opens the shelf in any app except these, and never in full-screen apps such as games. Use process names, e.g. krita or krita.exe.
mouse.onlyIn: The shelf currently opens only in: {{apps}}
mouse.screenEdgeDesc: While dragging, hold the pointer against this edge of the screen for a moment to open the shelf. With several monitors, only an outer edge of the whole desktop works, and not the edge where the taskbar is.

consent.title: Share usage data?
consent.description: Holdem checks for updates each time it starts. Apart from that, usage events are sent only if you choose to share them.
collectItems: When Holdem starts, and the Holdem and Windows versions
How the shelf was opened (shake, hotkey or tray) and which windows you open
How many items you add, drag out, remove or clear, and drops that fail (counts only)
Settings changes: start on login on or off, and that a hotkey was set (not which keys)
notCollectItems: Text, links or images you drop
consent.changeLater: You can change this at any time in Settings.
consent.privacyNote: Events go to PostHog (US servers) with a random ID made on this PC. PostHog sees your IP address when the app connects; Holdem turns off location lookup.
consent.startOnLogin: Start Holdem when I sign in to Windows
consent.webImages: When you drop an image from a web page, Holdem downloads it from that site, as your browser would. Links you drop are saved as shortcuts and not opened.
